resources.string: Help: %1$s
Choose country
Choose the released protocols used by your VPN profiles. Hysteria2 is selected when available. More protocols can be added after pairing the router.
Choose a phone profile to send to the router, or add one later.
When enabled, traffic associated with the selected country bypasses the router VPN. Tap the flag to choose or change the country.
Uses the router at home and restores the phone’s previous connection when you leave, if automatic switching is supported.
Adds this phone as a device on the home network, so its traffic can use the router VPN.
Choose this only if the router can be reached from the internet through a public IP. A mobile-network check is still required.
Creates a router VPN profile for this phone to use away from home. It does not prove that the router is reachable from the internet.
Enter the OpenWrt administrator password. The usual login is root; this is not the Wi-Fi password.

Choose your own four-digit PIN during first setup. Use that PIN to connect to a configured router. After manual package installation, set the PIN in LuCI using the owner account. There is no preset PIN.
Internal storage keeps VPN protocols after a restart. RAM saves internal storage but downloads the protocols again after a restart. Settings stay in internal storage.
Install adds FoxHole to a supported OpenWrt router. Connect pairs this phone with an existing FoxHole installation. OpenWrt firmware is not installed or upgraded.
Enables control of the paired router from this phone. Switching this off does not remove its VPN profiles.
Starts or stops the selected VPN profile on the router.
Choose whether each home device uses the router VPN or a direct connection.
These profiles connect to the router from outside your home network. You can share them or revoke access.
Removes only FoxHole settings, its PIN and client records. Set up FoxHole again afterward. OpenWrt and other apps keep their settings.

Automatic selection uses a fresh country result for the router’s internet connection. Phone and VPN location data are not used. If unavailable, previous rules stay unchanged; choose the country manually.
The router reports device status. Missing data means the status is unknown.

Enable only if this router will accept VPN connections from your devices over a public IP address. This installs a separate server package and increases memory use. You can configure access after installation.
